fieldData.description: All are welcome to join us for a pint of bitter and fish and chips in this historic 400-year-old pub nestled on the banks of the Thames! Anchor Bankside Just like the sailors of old, who took the call to adventure, we will be dreaming of a new world where we ride the wave of Radix to places we couldn’t even imagine! With Dan as captain and Piers as the first mate, who knows what glory and bounties await us!!
fieldData.location: Anchor Bankside, 31 Park St, London, SE1 9EF
fieldData.name: Community Meet Up - London, England
